svg.text: Register tiling (regtile): each thread computes a 4 × 4 block of C
Block = 16 × 16 threads → 64 × 64 tile of C; K step = 8. Per k: 2 shared loads (128-bit), 16 FMAs in registers.
k = 3, rows ty·4 .. ty·4+3 → one float4 a[0..3]
k = 3, cols tx·4 .. tx·4+3 → one float4 b[0..3]
Shared loads per multiply-add: tiled 1.25 (scalar) → regtile 2 / 16 = 0.125 (128-bit) → vec128 (8 × 8) 4 / 64 = 0.0625
Each A value is reused 4× (TN) and each B value 4× (TM) from registers instead of being re-read from shared memory.
Padding As by 4 makes the transposed store conflict-free and keeps rows 16-byte aligned for the float4 reads.
